title: 第25章 刑长老的茫然第26章 偷师
content_zh:
次日，柳随风领着几名弟兄，骑着七八匹战马，再入老律观，经通报之后，过两界牌楼，直入妙手堂。
众人行至妙手堂门前时，早有童子进去通报。
刑长老闻讯出迎，寒暄两句，目光便落在那几匹战马上。
“柳百户的座驾，看着倒是神骏，不知有何不妥？”
柳随风拱手：“前些日子校猎灵界，伤了腿脚，虽经医治，总觉得脚力有损。久闻刑长老医术通玄，特来请长老掌眼，看看是否留有暗伤，也好安心。”
刑长老颔首，也不多言，上前几步，仔细查看战马起来。
一时间，四下寂然。
倪紫君侍立一侧，目光落在马腿上几道淡淡刀痕上，心头莫名一跳。
她嘴唇微动，抬眼看着刑长老认真检查模样，终究又将话咽了回去。
片刻，刑长老收手，又换了一匹战马探查。
如此反复，没多久，他眉头舒展，微笑道：
“柳百户多虑了，这几匹战马只是腿骨新伤初愈，故而脚力不显，好生豢养一段时间，应该就能恢复如初。”
柳随风闻言轻轻松了一口气，抱拳道：
“刑长老这么说，柳某便放心了。实不相瞒，这几匹战马伤了腿骨之后，本来就要准备处死，还多亏了妙手堂倪仙子和陈知白的救治，这才转危为安。”
刑长老脸上笑意一凝，蓦然回头看了一眼倪紫君，又看向柳随风：
“莫不是十几天前，那批换骨之马？”
“正是！若非陈知白道友以换骨之术，为它们续接新骨，又有倪仙子药石救治，这些战马怕是早已化为枯骨。”
“柳道友谬赞……”
刑长老尴尬应道，眉眼间尽是不可思议。
“不知陈知白道友可还在？”

刑长老脸色一僵：“这个……陈知白他日前已然另谋高就去了。”
“另谋高就？”
柳随风一怔，深深看了刑长老一眼，没再多问，微笑拱手道：“既然如此，那柳某叨扰了。”
说罢，旋即翻山上马离去。
待人走远，刑长老脸色彻底沉了下来。
看向倪紫君道：“那陈知白可动用了什么神通？譬如血脉神通？”
倪紫君下意识道：“没有。”
“你确定？”
倪紫君面露回忆之色，半晌肯定颔首道：“弟子确定！”
刑长老沉默片刻，忽地转身，对身后一名弟子低喝道：
“速去奔云马坊，找那韩祁森，仔细查验一下他那匹烟霞驹状况，速来报我！”
“是！”那弟子领命而去。
不过半个时辰，弟子匆匆返回，气喘吁吁道：
“长老，查清了！那烟霞驹已然无碍，腿脚灵活如初，精气旺盛，睹之，不似断腿之马。”
刑长老闻言拢在袖中的双手陡然攥紧。
他闭眼深深吸了一口气，再睁开时，眼中已尽是决然：
“去！寻找各类飞禽走兽一对，要活的，尤其是马匹，我要实验换骨之法。另外，再将《沈氏疡科补遗》、《移肢换脏论》那几部旧典，全都给我找来！”
妙手堂深处，很快弥漫起一股凝重的气氛。
各类鸡鸭牛马，乃至马匹麋鹿，统统被送往妙手堂深处。
数名医术精湛弟子被留下，辅助刑长老实验换骨之法。

尤其是倪紫君，更是重点对象。
刑长老换骨之时，不时追问几句，若不是倪紫君不擅长手术，怕是已然让倪紫君现场演示起来。
说实话，关于换骨之法，刑长老并未亲自实验过。
他从医书中，了解到关于沈书言换骨实验的始末之后，便不再钻研。
content_en:
The next day, Liu Suifeng led several brothers, riding seven or eight war horses, and entered Laolv Temple again. After being informed, they passed the two archways and went straight to Miaoshou Hall.
When everyone arrived at the gate of Miaoshou Hall, a boy had already come in to report.
After hearing the news, Elder Xing came out to greet them. After a few words of greeting, his eyes fell on the horses.
"Liu Baihu's car looks like a divine horse. I wonder what's wrong with it?"
Liu Suifeng held up his hands: "A few days ago, I injured my legs and feet while hunting in the spirit world. Although I have been treated, I still feel that the strength of my feet has been damaged. I have heard that Elder Xing has great medical skills, so I came here to ask the elder to see if there are any hidden injuries, so that I can feel at ease."
Elder Xing nodded, without saying much, took a few steps forward and looked at the horse carefully.
For a moment, everything was silent.
Ni Zijun stood on one side, his eyes fell on the faint knife marks on the horse's legs, and his heart skipped an inexplicable jump.
She moved her lips slightly, raised her eyes to look at Elder Xing's careful inspection, and finally swallowed the words back.
After a moment, Elder Xing stopped and replaced another war horse to investigate.
After repeating this process, before long, he relaxed his brows and said with a smile:
"Liu Baihu is overly worried. These war horses are just recovering from new leg injuries, so their legs are weak. If they are well fed for a while, they should be able to recover as before."
Liu Suifeng breathed a sigh of relief after hearing this, cupped his fists and said:
"When Elder Xing said this, Liu felt relieved. To be honest, after these horses injured their leg bones, they were about to be executed. Thanks to the treatment of Fairy Ni and Chen Zhibai of Miaoshou Hall, they were able to turn the corner."
The smile on Elder Xing's face froze, and he suddenly turned back to glance at Ni Zijun, then looked at Liu Suifeng:
"Could it be those reborn horses more than ten days ago?"
"Exactly! If Taoist fellow Taoist Chen Zhibai hadn't used the bone-replacing technique to add new bones to them, and had Fairy Ni's medicinal stones to treat them, these war horses would have turned into withered bones long ago."
"Fellow Daoist Liu is so complimentary..."
Elder Xing responded awkwardly, his eyebrows filled with disbelief.
"I wonder if Fellow Taoist Chen Zhibai is still here?"
Elder Xing's expression froze: "Well...Chen Zhibai had already left looking for another job a few days ago."
"Looking for another job?"
Liu Suifeng was startled, and took a deep look at Elder Xing. Without asking any more questions, he smiled and said with cupped hands, "In that case, Liu is sorry for bothering you."
After saying that, he immediately climbed up the mountain and left on horseback.
When the person walked away, Elder Xing's expression completely darkened.
He looked at Ni Zijun and said, "Then what magical powers can Chen Zhibai use? For example, bloodline magical powers?"
Ni Zijun subconsciously said: "No."
"Are you sure?"
Ni Zijun's face showed a look of reminiscence, and after a while he nodded and said: "Disciple, you are sure!"
Elder Xing was silent for a moment, then suddenly turned around and shouted to a disciple behind him:
"Hurry to Benyun Horse Farm, find Han Qisen, carefully check the condition of his haze horse, and come and repay me!"
"Yes!" The disciple took the order and left.
Within half an hour, the disciple hurriedly returned, panting and saying:
"Elder, we've found out! The Yanxia horse is no longer in harm's way, its legs and feet are as flexible as before, and its energy is strong. It doesn't look like a horse with a broken leg."
When Elder Xing heard this, his hands in his sleeves suddenly clenched tightly.
He closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, his eyes were filled with determination:
"Go! Find a pair of various kinds of birds and animals that need to be alive, especially horses. I want to experiment with the method of bone replacement. In addition, find me all the old classics such as "Shen's Supplement to the Department of Ulcerology" and "On Transplanting Limbs and Replacing Internal Organs"!"
A solemn atmosphere soon filled the depths of Miaoshou Hall.
All kinds of chickens, ducks, cattle, horses, and even horses and elk were sent to the depths of Miaoshou Hall.
Several disciples with excellent medical skills were left behind to assist Elder Xing in experimenting with bone reshaping methods.
Especially Ni Zijun is a key target.
When Elder Xing was reshaping his bones, he asked questions from time to time. If Ni Zijun wasn't good at surgery, he might have asked Ni Zijun to demonstrate it on the spot.
To be honest, Elder Xing has not personally experimented with the method of bone replacement.
He learned about Shen Shu from medical booksAfter changing the story of the experiment, we stopped delving into it.
